services.desc: Experience the Connecticut shoreline from the deck of Ardent. Book your private charter today! We offer sunset cruises and day sails on Long Island Sound, departing from Westbrook, Connecticut. Ardent is a well-equipped, 30-foot sailboat certified by the U.S. Coast Guard. She offers a smooth, comfortable ride for those looking to experience the water in a more personal and peaceful way. Captain Chip, holds a 100-ton USCG Master Mariner license and brings years of experience sailing the U.S. East Coast - from Maryland to Canada - as well as extensive offshore
